about|series|between him and her.url: Drama Romance  It is the story of a long-time couple whose relationship has cooled down and is threatened due to the seven-year itch. Han Sung Ok is a jewelry worker in the business run by her and her boyfriend, Jung Hyun Sung, who works as a fashion designer. One night, Han Sung Ok and Jung Hyun Sung come face to face with each other in front of a motel elevator. They are each accompanied by another person.

about|series|boston blue.url: Drama Crime  In  Boston Blue , NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a position with Boston PD. Once in Boston, he is paired with Detective Lena Silver, the eldest daughter of a prominent law enforcement family.

about|series|branding in seongsu.url: Drama Fantasy Romance  A relentless marketing executive and a warm-hearted intern are always at odds with each other but everything takes a wild turn when their souls switch after an unexpected kiss.

about|series|coroner.url: Drama Crime Medical  Jenny Cooper, a former ER doctor and newly appointed coroner, investigates suspicious deaths. Suffering from anxiety and recently widowed with a teenage son, Jenny is a woman of action driven by an intense desire for the truth.

about|series|dive into you.url: Fantasy Romance  Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

about|series|dream to you.url: Drama Comedy Romance  A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.

about|series|elsbeth.url: Drama Comedy Crime   Elsbeth  follows Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney who utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD. After leaving her successful legal career in Chicago to tackle a new investigative role in New York City, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with the toast of the NYPD, Captain C.W. Wagner, a charismatic and revered leader. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, a stoic and ethical officer who quickly develops an appreciation for Elsbeth's insightful and offbeat ways.

about|series|fbi most wanted.url: Drama Crime   FBI: Most Wanted  is a high-stakes drama that focuses on the Fugitive Task Force, which relentlessly tracks and captures the notorious criminals on the Bureau's Most Wanted list. Seasoned agent Jess LaCroix oversees the highly skilled team that functions as a mobile undercover unit that is always out in the field, pursuing those who are most desperate to elude justice.

about|series|firefly wedding.url: Drama Anime Romance  Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she's determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: "Marry me, and we'll have it all." Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

about|series|flower crew joseon marriage.url: Comedy Romance History  Before Lee Soo became a king, he was an ordinary blacksmith in the countryside. He life suddenly changed at the age of 23. This was when Lee Soo became the King of Joseon. Meanwhile, Lee Soo's first love is Gae-Ddong. He loved her before he took the throne. King Lee Soo wants to marry Gae Ddong, but, because of her humble background, it is virtually impossible. To marry Gae-Ddong, Lee Soo hires the Flower Crew Matchmaking Agency. The agency consists of 3 handsome men: Ma Hoon, Do Joon and Ko Young Soo, and they are the best matchmaking agency in Joseon. King Lee Soo asks the Flower Crew to make Gae Ddong a noble woman.

about|series|francesca next door.url: Comedy Romance Supernatural  Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

about|series|hide.url: Drama Thriller  In  Hide , a Jekyll & Hyde tale by way of a conspiracy thriller, a disgraced journalist stumbles upon a story that could resurrect his career. But he quickly learns he's seen something he shouldn't have, and is now the target of unknown adversaries who will do anything to silence him. On the run as people around him go missing or die, a serious accident has an extraordinary side effect, and he realizes there are monsters in the world – and he may be one of them.

about|series|hotel del luna.url: Drama Fantasy Romance  The Hotel Del Luna, located in Seoul, is not like any other hotel: its client are all ghosts. Jang Man Wol, stuck in the hotel for the past millennium, meets Goo Chan Sung, the new manager.

about|series|love in sync.url: Drama Comedy Romance  An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

about|series|lupin.url: Drama Adventure Crime  Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

about|series|my bias my boss.url: Comedy Romance  For thirteen years, Nam Da Reum has been a dedicated fan of idol star Lee Chan. When she lands a job at fashion company APPELLO, she's shocked to find out that her beloved idol co-founded the company. Da Reum resolves to hide her identity as a fan and prove that she can be a professional. However, when she starts work, she's faced instead with workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, Chan's childhood friend. Meanwhile, Ha Gi seems to harbor hidden, unrequited feelings for Chan, and Chan struggles to maintain his public persona while dealing with a complicated personal life. As the three become entangled, Da Reum finds herself caught between her past obsession with Chan and a growing, unexpected connection with Ha Gi.    .

about|series|ncis sydney.url: Drama Action Crime  With rising international tensions in the Indo-Pacific, a brilliant and eclectic team of U.S. NCIS agents and the Australian Federal Police (AFP) are grafted into a multinational taskforce to keep naval crimes in check in the most contested patch of ocean on the planet.

about|series|one of a kind romance.url: Comedy Romance   One of a Kind Romance  follows the story of an ordinary job-seeker whose everyday life is suddenly disrupted by a celebrated actor and a rising idol, leading to a romance brimming with personal desires.

about|series|queen of masks.url: Drama Thriller Mystery  A story that takes place in front of three successful friends when an old friend who became a murderer due to their lies 10 years ago, appears. The four face a whirlwind of life because of a man, and start a war of jealousy and desire.

about|series|s w a t.url: Drama Action Crime  Shemar Moore stars as a locally born and raised S.W.A.T. sergeant newly tasked to run a specialized tactical unit that is the last stop in law enforcement in Los Angeles. Torn between loyalty to where he was raised and allegiance to his brothers in blue, former Marine Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson has everything it takes to be an excellent leader and bridge the divide between his two worlds.

about|series|sight unseen.url: Drama Crime  Homicide detective Tess Avery is forced to quit the job she loves after nearly killing her partner and being diagnosed as clinically blind. Reluctant to accept help, Tess uses an assistance app and connects with Sunny Patel, a professional seeing-eye guide and agoraphobe living 3,000 miles away. Haunted by the unsolved cases she left behind, Tess uses a hidden camera and earpiece, while Sunny remotely steers Tess through life's obstacles -- and crimes -- as the two challenge preconceptions about ability, trust and where to draw the line.

about|series|strangers again.url: Comedy Romance  Divorce is easy and separation is difficult Divorce lawyers' love and life growth period.

about|series|the beauty inside.url: Drama Fantasy Romance  Top actress Han Se Kye is known to be a troublemaker and object to many rumours. While her life is for many a mystery, she actually suffers an unusual phenomenon in which her appearance changes to a complete different person once every month. One day she bumps into Seo Do Jae, an executive of an airline. Even though Seo Do Jae is unable to recognize faces, he tries his best to hide his issue and to memorize people by their habits and mannerisms.

about|series|the judge returns.url: Drama Fantasy Legal  Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.

about|series|the rules.url: A man takes a night-shift job at a mysterious convenience store, where employees must follow a strict set of strange rules. Breaking these rules can unleash terrifying supernatural events, forcing him to confront the dark secrets surrounding the store.

about|series|weekly idol.url: Weekly Idol is a South Korean variety show, which airs at 6 PM every Wednesday nights on MBC Every1, MBC's cable and satellite network for comedy and variety shows. The show is hosted by comedian Jeong Hyeong Don and rapper Defconn.

about|series|where the mask ends.url: Drama Romance  Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

about|series|your honor.url: Thriller Legal   Your Honor  follows the son of a respected judge who is involved in a hit and run. Soon after they are both drawn into a high-stakes game of lies, deceit and impossible choices when it comes to light that the victim was the son of a notorious crime boss.

about|series|your personal taxi.url: Drama Music  There are times when all we want is for someone to truly listen to our story. And sometimes, we come across a song that feels like it's telling that story for us. Welcome to  Your Personal Taxi —a special ride where music plays alongside memories, and your story is met with a listening ear. This isn't just any car—it's a personalized classic, and there's something quietly mysterious about it. Passengers with ordinary yet extraordinary lives step in to share personal stories, along with the songs that carry their emotions.
